How we know

Standing Boy Trails’ home page lists group rides Sundays at 3 PM and Thursdays at 6:00 PM, meet in the Upper Lot, beside Oct to Dec 2026 hunt dates (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

Kind of ride

For visitors

Check the trail status on the home page first; the biking trailhead closes when trails are too wet. A parking pass is required. Archery hunts close the trails on listed dates (Oct 2 to 4, Nov 6 to 8 and 13 to 15, Dec 4 to 6, 2026).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @standingboytrails the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Standing Boy Trails Thursday Group Ride group ride

Standing Boy Trails Thursday Group Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Columbus, GA. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Standing Boy Trails, Upper Lot.

A weekly group mountain bike ride at Standing Boy Trails on the Chattahoochee in north Columbus. Meet in the Upper Lot. Standing Boy has about 30 miles of natural-surface trail.
